question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

It is high time you **must change your habits.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**changed your habits**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**It is high time**" is followed by the past tense form of the verb.
 
• The correct past tense form of the verb here is "**changed**".
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"It is high time you **changed your habits**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "must have changed your habits"** is incorrect as it does not fit the structure "It is high time".
 
• **Option 3: "change your habit"** is incorrect as "change" should be in the past tense "changed", and "habits" should be plural.
 
• **Option 4: "will change the habit"** is incorrect as it does not follow the correct tense structure and does not use the appropriate noun form.
